name: Media Cleaner and Database Optimizer by ITPath
author: IT Path Solutions

sections.description:
Media Cleaner and Database Optimizer by ITPath helps you manage unused media files and clean unnecessary data from your WordPress database.

The plugin allows you to identify media files that are not associated with posts or pages and remove them safely. It also provides tools to clean unused database data such as revisions, drafts, transients, and metadata.

By keeping your media library and database organized, the plugin helps maintain a cleaner WordPress installation and supports smooth site operation.

Features

  1. Media Cleaner

    • View all media files utilized on your site.
    • Easily clear unused media not associated with any posts or pages.
    • Streamline media management by deleting unused files.
    • Detect media usage across your website effortlessly.
    • Save time by skipping the cleanup process for media files that are in use.

  2. Database Cleaner

    • Inactive & unused Plugins cleaner
    • Inactive & unused Themes cleaner
    • Revision clean up
    • Draft clean up
    • Auto draft clean up
    • Post meta clean up
    • Comment meta clean up
    • All comments clean up
    • User meta clean up
    • Term meta clean up
    • Trashed post & product clean ip
    • Trashed post / product clean up
    • Transients clean up
    • Pingback & trackback clean up
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload itpathsolutions-media-cleaner-and-database-optimizer to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. You will find WP Optimizer in your WordPress admin screen.
